items.q: What are the formal elements of art?
items.correct: Line, shape, form, tone, texture, pattern, colour and space.
items.random_wrong: Just whether a piece looks neat.
items.why: The formal elements are the building blocks artists combine.

items.q: Does good artwork need development and planning?
items.correct: Yes — through studies, experiments and refinement.
items.misconception: No, the first attempt is the final piece.
items.why: The creative process is central to art.

items.correct: The range from light to dark that creates form.
items.why: Varying tone makes objects look three-dimensional.
